Name: Krobus Roommate Dialogue Expansion
Author: SHASHFORGE
Description:
[b][color=#b45f06][size=5][font=Arial Black]Krobus Marriage Dialogue Expanded[/font][/size][/color][/b]
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Krobus Marriage Dialogue Expanded[/b] gives your life with Krobus a much deeper and more varied set of conversations.
This expansion adds [b]2000+ new dialogue moments[/b] for Krobus, bringing fresh conversations to different days, times, seasons, weather conditions, and special occasions throughout the year.
Instead of repeatedly seeing the same small collection of post-roommate dialogue, Krobus now has a much larger range of conversations designed to make your time together feel more dynamic and personal.
The dialogue focuses on Krobus's unusual perspective on the surface world, his mysterious nature, curiosity, kindness, humor, friendships, and his life alongside you.
The mod is focused entirely on [b]expanding Krobus's dialogue[/b]. It does not change his appearance, friendship mechanics, schedule, gifts, or other gameplay systems.

[heading]🕐 More Conversations Throughout the Day[/heading]
Krobus's conversations are organized around multiple points throughout the day instead of relying on a small collection of general post-roommate lines.
Dialogue opportunities are available around:
[b]6:00 AM → 8:00 AM → 10:00 AM → 12:00 PM → 2:00 PM → 4:00 PM → 6:00 PM → 8:00 PM → 10:00 PM[/b]
This gives conversations a more natural daily rhythm and allows Krobus to have different things to say depending on when you speak with him.
[line]
[heading]📅 Full Calendar Dialogue[/heading]
The expansion covers the complete Stardew Valley calendar.
Dialogue can be written specifically for:
[list]
[*]Spring 1–28[/*]
[*]Summer 1–28[/*]
[*]Fall 1–28[/*]
[*]Winter 1–28[/*]
[/list]This allows conversations to change throughout the year instead of relying only on generic seasonal dialogue.
[line]
[heading]🌦️ Situational Dialogue[/heading]
Krobus can have different conversations based on the current situation.
Examples include:
[list]

[*]Special occasions[/*]
[*]Morning conversations[/*]

[*]Night-time conversations[/*]
[/list]This makes his conversations feel more connected to the current day and circumstances.
[line]
[heading]💬 More Natural Conversations[/heading]
The goal isn't simply to add a huge number of random lines.
The dialogue is written to make Krobus feel like he is [b]actually living alongside you[/b].
Conversations can cover topics such as:

[*]His experiences and thoughts[/*]
[/list]The result is a more varied Krobus experience with conversations that can feel mysterious, funny, unexpected, thoughtful, or heartfelt.
[line]
[heading]📝 Editable Dialogue[/heading]
The dialogue content is stored in an external [b]JSON file[/b], making it easy for players and creators to customize the mod.
You can:
[list]
[*]Change existing lines[/*]
[*]Add new dialogue[/*]
[*]Remove dialogue[/*]
[*]Create additional variations[/*]
[*]Personalize Krobus's conversations[/*]
[*]Create your own dialogue expansion[/*]
[/list]To edit the dialogue, go to:
[code]Stardew Valley\Mods\MarriageDialogueExpansion\content[/code]Then open:
[code]Krobus.json[/code]Search for the [b]specific day and time[/b] you want to change, then edit or add your own dialogue.
You do not need to modify the source code just to change dialogue.

[heading]⚠️ Important[/heading]
This mod is intended for [b]post-roommate Krobus gameplay[/b].
The expansion is designed to add variety to Krobus's existing conversations rather than replacing his character, appearance, schedule, friendship system, or gameplay mechanics.
Because the mod contains a large amount of dialogue, different conversations are tied to particular [b]days, times, seasons, weather, and situations[/b]. What you see depends on when you interact with Krobus.
